provenance: The unapproved half of the Millbrook Influent Pump Station (source key PH_2) dictionary. export_dictionary_review puts these under "pending", which apply_dictionary_review does not read, so replaying only the approvals would land a deployment with these points bare and looking unreviewed. Each entry here carries the reason already recorded against the point locally.
policy: Withholding records a decision; it binds nothing and changes no reading. Apply this after the approvals pack so a point that is meant to be approved is never left holding only a reason.

withhold.reason: Carries a measurement no other tag provides, but nothing states what it measures. "MV_PMP_DRF_TB_PT" is a vendor abbreviation: it does not appear in published tag-naming conventions, and the observed values do not identify the quantity - a median around 35 fits degC, percent and metres equally. A catalogue entry must name a component and a physical kind, which is a stronger claim than a unit and would rest on nothing but the abbreviation. ASK THE PLANT: the OPC-UA tag list for PS1_PROG_19_4_2019, or simply what MV_PMP_DRF_TB_PT measures on bay P10. Ownership is settled - the node id names the bay - so the unit review can proceed the moment the meaning is known.

Instrument fails under load, so the channel is unusable however the unit is labelled.
